name: Aquatica

categories.label: Character cards in hand (incl. King)
categories.hint: 1 Prosperity Point per Character card in hand, including your King; discarded ones do not count.

categories.label: Goal track points
categories.hint: Sum of points shown above each of your Mantas on the Goal Tracks.

categories.label: Locations in Scoring Pile
categories.hint: Sum of points printed on Locations in your Scoring Pile; Locations still on your player board score 0.

tiebreakers.description: Then lowest number on King card; without Kings, last player in turn order wins.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Goal Track point values are printed on the board/tokens and not in the rulebook text, so entered as a number. End: after any of 4 goals claimed by one player, Location deck empty or Ocean Character deck empty, each player takes one final turn. Solo mode and Advanced Mode goals not modelled.

sources.title: Aquatica Rulebook (Arcane Wonders)
sources.section: p.24 Goals; p.25 End of the Game / Counting Prosperity Points
